dataset: NASA POWER climatology API v2.10.1 (MERRA-2 reanalysis; Jan 2001 - Dec 2025): TS TS_MAX TS_MIN PS TQV
original_units: C (TS TS_MAX TS_MIN); kPa (PS); kg m-2 (TQV)
processing_notes: Regional requests in 10 x 10 deg boxes. mean = annual (ANN) TS; high / low = average of the 12 monthly TS_MAX / TS_MIN; all POWER points inside each 2 deg cell averaged. PS annual mean x 1000 to Pa; TQV annual mean (1 kg m-2 = 1 mm). Reanalysis: less reliable where observations are sparse (poles and deserts).

dataset: NASA POWER climatology API v2.10.1 (CERES SYN1deg; Jan 2001 - Dec 2025): ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN
processing_notes: All-sky surface shortwave downward irradiance (clouds included) on a horizontal surface. Regional requests in 10 x 10 deg boxes; annual (ANN) value, else mean of 12 months; all POWER points inside each 2 deg cell averaged; x 1000 / 24 to W m-2 (day-and-night mean). Satellite-derived (CERES) with model inputs.

dataset: LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer Global Cumulative Product (Williams et al. 2017; PDS bundle urn:nasa:pds:lro_diviner_derived1 collection data_derived_gcp; nadir data Jul 2009 - Apr 2015): tbol
processing_notes: Direct measurements. 18 GLOBAL_CUMUL_AVG_CYL tiles. Per 2 deg cell the 16 bins are averaged for each of the 96 local-time slots to give a daily curve; gaps filled circularly; mean / max / min of the curve; K to C (minus 273.15). pressure_pa and water_vapour_mm set to 0 (no atmosphere; exosphere about 3e-10 Pa) and not taken from Diviner. wind_ms and aerosol_tau set to 0 (no atmosphere) and not taken from Diviner.

dataset: Computed (no dataset): daily-mean insolation formula with solar constant 1361 W m-2 and lunar axial tilt 1.54 deg to the ecliptic
processing_notes: No atmosphere, so sunlight at the ground = geometry. Daily-mean insolation averaged over the year at each 2 deg cell-centre latitude (equator 433 W m-2). Smooth sphere: ignores topography, so polar crater rims (lit up to ~90 % of the time) and permanently shadowed floors are not resolved; LRO LOLA polar illumination maps would capture them.

dataset: Mars Climate Database v6.2 web interface (LMD / CNRS with ESA and CNES; climatology scenario; average solar): tsurf ps col_h2ovapor fluxsurf_dn_sw u v dod
original_units: K (tsurf); Pa (ps); kg m-2 (col_h2ovapor); W m-2 (fluxsurf_dn_sw); m s-1 (u v at 2 m above the surface); no unit (dod)
processing_notes: Climate model output (not measurements; not NASA). tsurf: 12 seasons (Ls 15 to 345) x 24 local times; per season mean / max / min over local times; seasons weighted by length in sols. ps and col_h2ovapor: 12 seasons x 4 local times (0 6 12 18 h); season-weighted yearly mean. Bilinear interpolation to 2 deg cell centres; K to C; 1 kg m-2 = 1 mm. fluxsurf_dn_sw (solar flux to surface; dust and clouds included): 12 seasons x 12 local times (every 2 h) because sunlight is zero at night; season-weighted yearly day-and-night mean; bilinear interpolation to 2 deg. u and v (west-east and south-north wind 2 m above the local surface): 12 seasons x 8 local times (every 3 h); speed sqrt(u2+v2) per map then season-weighted mean (climatological means, so day-to-day gusts cancel and real mean speeds are somewhat higher). dod (visible dust column optical depth): 12 seasons x 2 local times (0 and 12 h); season-weighted mean.
